articles.title: Frustration mounts for thousands still without power after deadly Indiana storms - CBS News
articles.description: Several days of powerful storms walloped northwest Indiana, killing at least seven people and displacing about 1,000. The storms brought record rainfall that flooded several communities.
articles.content:
Like so many in Gary, Indiana, Shatiya Hardin has been waiting for the minute her power finally turns back on.
